name: gg-payroll-social-insurance
description: Prepare ordinary 2026 Class 1 payroll and Class 2/Class 3 contribution working papers, including current-year income bases, mixed employment/self-employment, assessment certificates and reassessments. Includes ordinary benefit valuation, vehicle and housing scales, and ETI reporting. Exact threshold, rounding and discretionary partial-year outcomes remain subject to the stated limits. This source-cited draft supports preparation of reviewable working papers using the stated periods, evidence requirements and computation examples. Retain source evidence and effective dates; unresolved points and professional review remain explicit. Use the linked official materials when checking a case, and obtain a qualified local review before filing or making a payment. Read the explicit exclusions before applying its calculations to different facts.
